sql.schedule.getEvents: with resource as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.int_value, cfga.custom_field_group_id, cfga.custom_field_id and ppscfv.int_value is not null and ARRAY [ppscfv.int_value] <@ coalesce(ARRAY [ :combined ]::INT[], '{}') ), start_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value, cfga.custom_field_group_id from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on cfga.id = ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id inner join resource r on r.project_process_step_id = ppscfv.project_process_step_id where cfga.schedule_field_type_id = 1 ), end_time as ( select ppscfv.id, ppscfv.custom_field_group_assignment_id, ppscfv.project_process_step_id, ppscfv.timestamp_value, cfga.custom_field_group_id from flow.project_process_step_custom_field_value ppscfv inner as "end", r.int_value as resource_id, u.id as user_id, c.id as contact_id, c.first_name as contact_first_name, c.last_name as contact_last_name, c.latitude, c.longitude, case when sl.system_list_type_id = 1 then o.org_name else concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) end as resource_name, p.project_name, ps.process_step_name, p.state_id, s.state, pps.company_process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type from resource r inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = r.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = r.project_process_step_id inner join end_time et on et.project_process_step_id = pps.id and et.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id inner join start_time st on st.project_process_step_id = pps.id and st.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id inner join flow.project p on p.id = pps.project_id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.contact c on c.id = p.contact_id inner join flow.state s on s.id = p.state_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = r.custom_field_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = r.int_value left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id left join flow.org o on o.id = r.int_value inner join flow.company_system_list csl on csl.id = cf.company_system_list_id inner join flow.system_list sl on sl.id = csl.system_list_id where cfg.event_type_id is not null and cfg.archived is not true and st.timestamp_value is not null and et.timestamp_value is not null and r.int_value is not null and case when :startTime::timestamp is not null then st.timestamp_value >= :startTime::timestamp else 1=1 end and case when :endTime::timestamp is not null then et.timestamp_value <= :endTime::timestamp else 1=1 end
sql.schedule.getAvailability: with dates as ( select :startTime::date + d.date as date, extract(dow from :startTime::date + d.date) + 1 as day_of_week_id from generate_series(0, 99) as d(date) where :startTime::date + d.date BETWEEN :startTime::date and :endTime::date - 1 ) select coalesce(rs.user_id, rs.org_id) as resource_id, (concat(d.date, ' ', rsa.start_time))::timestamp as "start", (concat(d.date, ' ', rsa.end_time))::timestamp as "end", rsa.day_of_week_id, false as all_day, null as title, 'inverse-background' as rendering, case when rs.org_id is not null then 1 else 2 end as system_list_type_id from dates d inner join flow.resource_schedule_availability rsa on rsa.day_of_week_id = d.day_of_week_id inner join flow.resource_schedule rs on rs.id = rsa.resource_schedule_id and d.date between rs.start_date and rs.end_date where rs.archived is not true and rsa.archived is not true and ( case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[coalesce(rs.org_id, -1)] <@ ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[] end OR case when array_length(ARRAY [ :userIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY [coalesce(rs.user_id, -1)] <@ ARRAY [ :userIds ]::INTEGER[] end ) union all select coalesce(ra.user_id, ra.org_id) as resource_id, ra.start_time as "start", ra.end_time as "end", null::int, ra.all_day, ra.description as "title", 'background' as rendering, case when ra.org_id is not null then 1 else 2 end as system_list_type_id from flow.resource_appointment ra where ra.start_time >= :startTime::timestamp and ra.end_time <= :endTime::timestamp and ra.archived is not true and ( case when array_length(ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY[coalesce(ra.org_id, -1)] <@ ARRAY[ :orgIds ]::INTEGER[] end OR case when array_length(ARRAY [ :userIds ]::INTEGER[], 1) > 0 then ARRAY [coalesce(ra.user_id, -1)] <@ ARRAY [ :userIds ]::INTEGER[] end )
